object.name: evi.softclip~
object.description: A quick all purpose and efficient soft clipper. <o>evi.softclip~</o> does not have all the options of <o>evi.hardclip~</o> or <o>evi.clipper~</o>. It aims to be an easy <o>tanh~</o> replacement to drop in to audio chains. The algorithm is a 2nd order antiderivative antialiasing tanh approximation.
object.discussion: This object is for all those MSP users who use [<o>tanh~</o>] in their audio chains. You should avoid this - it can destroy your audio and aliases. Use <o>evi.softclip~</o> or <o>evi.clipper~</o> instead. These can antialias large gain inputs whilst retaining the soft clipping functionality you seek.
